reasoning: Both plans share correct native/image decisions and sheet grouping. A meets the rubric on alpha bleed, the darker glass-card fill, 2x glow, a 9-slice slot with SliceScale 0.5, and Fit for sprites, where B misses or deviates on each. B's native ribbon and logo-bounds observation don't make up for those gaps.

criteria.note: Keyboard, progress bar, glass card and NEW label are native; glyphs, icons, panel, slot, dot grid, badge, logo, glow and portraits are baked; avatar uses rbxthumb AvatarHeadShot.
Ribbon is a white 9-slice tinted with ImageColor3 (an accepted option); glass card uses a darker (42,44,52) fill at about 0.15 transparency instead of a BlurEffect.
Everything is 2x (64 px icons, 256 px portraits, glow 384); logo capped at 1024 x 384 at 1.333x, with an optional two-halves split and a stated trade-off.

criteria.criterion: Sheets grouped by what shows together
criteria.note: S1 for the 12 HUD icons; S2, S3 and S4 split by device; portraits, logo and 9-slice/tile images are single images.
Regular grids with 72/88/104 px cells, 4 px padding and explicit ImageRectOffset/ImageRectSize; icons exported white and tinted, console glyphs keep full color.
Dot tile is 48 px with TileSize fromOffset(24,24); panel and slot use Slice with pixel SliceCenter and SliceScale 0.5; sprites use ScaleType Fit.
Requires alpha bleed and covers every layer with exact numbers and no code; includes a dubious claim that sprite rects misplace on some phones.
Decisions are correct throughout; avatar uses the rbxthumb headshot.
Ribbon is native with patched corners (good), but the glass card keeps the 10% white fill and only suggests raising opacity if needed, instead of a darker, more opaque fill.
Icons, portraits and panel are 2x and the logo is capped at 1024w, but the glow is exported at 1x and the slot is sized at 2x its largest in-game size.

criteria.criterion: Sheets grouped by what shows together
criteria.note: Same correct grouping: HUD icon sheet, per-device prompt sheets, single portraits.
Same 72/88/104 px cells with 4 px inset and explicit offsets; white icons tinted, console glyphs in full color.
Dot tile and panel 9-slice are correct, but the slot is not a 9-slice and sprites default to Stretch rather than Fit.
Never mentions alpha bleed; otherwise complete with exact numbers, no code, and useful designer questions.

strengths: Covers the full rubric, including alpha bleed and SliceScale 0.5
Logo handled at the 1024 cap, with a split option
weaknesses: Ribbon baked as an image rather than built natively (acceptable)
Unsupported claim about sprite rects on mobile

strengths: Clear designer questions and asset table
